faqs.q1: Is it safe for my child?
faqs.a1: Every story passes a three-stage safety pipeline: prompt filtering before generation, moderation during generation, and a reviewable flag queue before anything reaches a child's device. There is no chat, no advertising, and no third-party tracking in child-facing views.
faqs.q2: Do children get their own logins?
faqs.a2: No. Parents and teachers hold the account; children sign in with a PIN or by tapping their avatar on a shared device. Each profile only ever sees its own content.
faqs.q3: Can my child appear as a character?
faqs.a3: Yes — as an illustrated character built from the details you provide. We never produce photo-real images of a child.
faqs.a4: English, Amharic, French, Arabic (with full right-to-left support), Spanish and Swahili, switchable in-app at any time.
faqs.a5: Dyslexia-friendly font toggle, adjustable text size and line spacing, color-blind-safe palettes, captions on narration, full keyboard navigation, and reduced-motion support.

testimonials.t1q: My son asks for ‘the one where I ride the cloud whale’ every single night. He's reading words he couldn't touch two months ago.

testimonials.t3q: The narration in my own voice meant bedtime still happened while I was away on tour. That's worth the subscription alone.
